check: language files: is the absence of assets/ a gap or by design?
finding: There is no assets/ directory and therefore no lang/*.json, which on first look resembles a missing resource. It is correct for this mod.

evidence.noteOnRegistration: No Registry.register call for ITEM or BLOCK exists, so there is no item or block name that would fall back to a raw translation key in the client.
feedbackExamples: S0 laboratory; production services OFF; counts=
evidence.note: No Chinese appears in Java string literals outside comments, so there is no half-localised surface either.

interpretation: Commands and their feedback are operator-facing diagnostics printed through Component.literal, which does not consult a lang file. With no registered content and no translatable component, a lang file would be dead weight rather than a fix.
